name: Unwip 0.44.7
body:
Behind the scenes: Unwip's home on GitHub is now called UnwipOfficial.
- The PC and Mac apps now look for updates at unwip.app first, with GitHub as a backup, so they keep updating whatever happens to the GitHub account.
- Download links point to the new GitHub name, and the old web address forwards to unwip.app.
